verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a commerce platform with Admin and Store REST APIs, so the axis applies. The pack only shows a pricing-page line "RBAC, SSO, Audit Logs", which is user role-based access control (an adjacent control), not documented issuance of scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for agents. Nothing in the evidence describes API key scopes, permission-limited tokens, or agent-specific credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
